registry_disposition.reason: S5 Path-Confinement Closure (owner ticket of 2026-10-21), a bounded closure of the path-confinement finding that the HO-01 lane's independent review reached by reproducing it against the shared S5 evaluation module and deliberately named rather than repairing, because that module is the S5 lane's surface. The S5 corpus loader in scripts/tools/run-skill-effectiveness-evals.mjs resolved every corpus-declared path LEXICALLY, so a family file that is a symbolic link out of the corpus directory, a family file reached through a symlinked parent directory inside the corpus, and a corpus directory that is itself a symbolic link out of the repository (CLI --corpus) all carried the evaluation out of the corpus the run is supposed to measure. The loader now confines every declared path to the corpus directory in REAL terms and binds every read to a verified file descriptor, through the new shared primitive scripts/tools/path-confinement.mjs, which proves containment twice and binds the read: C1 the declared path is relative and stays lexically inside the base; C2 the REAL path of the target stays inside the REAL path of the base, so a symlink inside the base that points out and a symlinked parent directory that carries the target out are both refused; C3 the content is read through a descriptor opened with O_NOFOLLOW and O_NONBLOCK on the verified real path, and the descriptor's device and inode identity and the parent directory's identity are compared with the identities observed during the check, so a target REPLACED in the window is detected instead of read and a FIFO swapped in cannot block the open; C4 the target must be a regular file, so a directory, a FIFO or a device can never be read as material; C5 the target must carry exactly one link, so a hardlink, which shares its inode with another name and whose real path is its own path, is refused rather than read. The CLI additionally requires the corpus directory to RESOLVE inside the repository and re-anchors it after the load. The manifest is validated instead of crashing on a malformed one, so a family can no longer be dropped from the measurement silently and leave the security gate passing with zero security cases measured. The corpus error vocabulary keeps CORPUS_PATH_ESCAPES_ROOT for a declared path that leaves the corpus and adds CORPUS_PATH_SYMLINK_ESCAPE, CORPUS_PATH_NOT_A_FILE, CORPUS_PATH_MULTIPLE_LINKS and CORPUS_PATH_CHANGED. The TOCTOU residual is documented and NOT claimed as eliminated: an in-place rewrite of the same inode is not detected, a concurrent writer that replaces the parent directory between the containment check and the open and carries a file with the same device and inode identity is not detectable without openat(2) relative to a trusted directory descriptor, a hung filesystem can still block in the kernel, and a bind mount inside the corpus is not detected. No CONTRACT_RECORD, PROVENANCE or SUPERSESSION class changes: core/contracts/behavioral-eval.schema.json is untouched, the behavioral-eval validator is untouched, the corpus content is untouched, the BehavioralEvalRecord format is untouched, nothing is superseded, and the evaluation output is digest-neutral (measured: the pristine origin/main tree and this branch produce byte-identical corpus digests, content digests and family digests, and an identical HO-01 comparison record). The runner is a tool surface, not a registered contract. Per the consumer binding in AGENTS.md, NO_CHANGE requires no Registry write; the change registration for this run is projected separately in the Unitera Registry, and the representation in the Unitera Atlas, after the source merge. The independent review of the slice was performed by a tool-driven reviewer on a model different from the one that wrote the slice, with one independent confirmer per finding; it confirmed thirteen findings and refuted one, and every confirmed finding was repaired in the same change. The outcome is recorded in full in the run record, section 6, with each finding and its disposition. No independent human approval is claimed.
